Products and intended use

moodytiger designs and sells children's activewear and related accessories. Our garments are clothing items intended for everyday wear, sport and outdoor play. They are not protective equipment, safety equipment or personal protective equipment, and they should not be relied upon to prevent injury.

Children should be supervised by a responsible adult during sport and outdoor activity. Age and size designations on our products are provided as fitting guidance only, and are not a safety certification for any particular activity.

Colours, sizes and product images

Product images are intended to represent our products as accurately as possible. Actual colours may vary depending on your screen settings and on normal variation between fabric production batches. Measurements are taken by hand and may vary slightly between individual items.

Performance and fabric claims

Descriptions of fabric performance — including but not limited to UV protection, water repellency, insulation, breathability and quick-drying properties — are based on laboratory testing carried out under controlled conditions. Real-world performance may differ depending on use, laundering, wear and environmental conditions. Please follow the care instructions provided with each garment.

References to these certifications describe our materials, supply chain or packaging, and do not constitute an independent warranty by moodytiger in respect of any individual finished item.
